cs.t: Good question. Not sure why it’s like this. Perhaps wifi is ubiquitous enough that most people don’t care…? My preferred solution: I carry a small 4g router (TP-Link M7350) in my backpack. Extremely useful when working in places that lack wifi (e.g. some coffee shops etc). The battery lasts very long.
